# Native refresh fixture (KiCad 10.0.6)

Authored independently with KiCad's bundled pcbnew Python API and PCB_IO_KICAD_SEXPR.FootprintSave on Windows. This is a field-and-rule-area footprint: it intentionally has no pads. It contains a hidden Datasheet and custom AssemblyVendor field with SetKeepUpright(False), and a four-vertex F.Cu rule area that disallows tracks, vias and copper fills while allowing pads and footprints. Library-child UUIDs are native generated IDs. No customer or third-party footprint geometry is included.

The ignored footprint_rule_area_live_test uses a separate disposable 19-instance board assembled from installed official libraries (two diodes, sixteen test points, one SHT4x sensor). Its initial native objects deliberately omit library attributes and the sensor rule area. Supply explicit KONNECT_REFRESH_TEST_BOARD, KONNECT_REFRESH_TEST_SOCKET, KONNECT_REFRESH_TEST_EVIDENCE and KICAD_CLI; isolate the KiCad process/profile/TEMP and the test process's library-resolution configuration. The required scratch filename is refresh-isolation.kicad_pcb. The test mutates and saves that disposable board, then verifies a second dry run is a noop. Never target a customer board.
